title: Pick your agent: Use Claude and Codex on Agent HQ
GitHub Agent HQ / Mission Control (Copilot, Claude, Codex side by side)
summary: Cross-vendor coding agents run inside GitHub and VS Code with shared repository context; one task can be assigned to several agents to compare results; org-wide agent controls, audit logs and metrics.
mechanism: Copilot Pro+/Enterprise users assign issues or PRs to Copilot, Claude or Codex (public preview since 2026-02-04); sessions run asynchronously, produce draft PRs and logs, and consume premium requests. Cross-vendor direction for repository work is already a platform feature.
rationale: Critical review: invalidates the claim that cross-vendor direction is an open seam for repository work; Starlight's wedge must be non-repo founder work, continuity and audience.

value: public preview (Copilot Pro+ and Enterprise), each session one premium request
